summary_en.core_problem: DiT-MoE diffusion inference suffers from redundant computation across timesteps; existing token-level caching is suboptimal because each token is routed into multiple expert branches.
summary_en.importance: Proposes MoECa, a fine-grained caching framework that reuses features at the expert-branch level across timesteps, offering practical inference speedup for DiT-MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Observes that cross-timestep redundancy in DiT-MoE is better characterized at expert-branch level; MoECa performs branch-level feature reuse with expert-aware adaptive control and synchronized cache updates across MoE and attention paths to maintain stable intermediate states.
summary_en.experiments: Consistent better speed-quality trade-off than prior caching methods across multiple DiT-MoE models, up to 2.83× inference speedup.

recommendation.zh: DiT-MoE推理效率工作，对扩散模型Serving有参考，LLM预训练研究员可只看摘要和实验表格。
recommendation.en: DiT-MoE inference efficiency work; relevant to diffusion serving but marginal for LLM pretrain; read abstract and experiment tables only.

paper.title: Training-free sparse attention based on cumulative energy filtering
paper.abstract: Sparse attention accelerates Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for video generation by computing only the important tokens while skipping the rest. The token selection strategy is key to balancing sparsity and accuracy. We formulate the token filtering process as a dual-goal optimization problem: maximizing sparsity and minimizing accuracy degradation. Existing algorithms cannot fulfill both objectives simultaneously. For example, Top-p only considers the accuracy constraint, while Top-k maintains a

summary.core_problem: 解决视频生成 Diffusion Transformer 推理中稠密 attention 成本高、现有稀疏 token 选择难以同时保证精度和计算节省的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理加速方法，面向 DiT 视频生成的 sparse attention；和 LLM 预训练不是同一主线，但对长序列 attention 稀疏化和 FlashAttention 集成有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 token filtering 表述为同时最大化稀疏率、最小化精度损失的双目标问题；论文主张固定 recall rate 足以约束精度，而固定阈值会浪费计算，因此提出动态阈值策略，并和 FlashAttention 深度集成，避免额外 mask 计算开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频生成模型、分辨率、token 数、速度提升或质量指标；作者声称在相同精度水平下提高稀疏率，并通过 FlashAttention 集成消除额外 masking overhead。

summary_en.core_problem: Reduces the cost of dense attention in video-generation Diffusion Transformers, where existing sparse token-selection rules struggle to preserve quality while saving compute.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference acceleration method for DiT video generation. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but the sparse-attention criterion and FlashAttention integration are useful engineering signals for long-sequence systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates token filtering as a dual-objective problem: maximize sparsity while minimizing accuracy degradation. It argues that a fixed recall rate is enough to preserve accuracy, whereas a fixed threshold is compute-inefficient, then introduces dynamic thresholding integrated tightly with FlashAttention to avoid extra masking overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the exact video model, resolution, token count, speedup, or quality metrics. It claims higher sparsity at the same accuracy level and no additional masking overhead due to FlashAttention integration.

recommendation.zh: 只看动态阈值和 FA 集成细节即可；结论若成立，可作为长序列 attention 裁剪的弱工程信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the dynamic-thresholding and FlashAttention integration details; if the claim holds, it is a weak but useful signal for long-sequence attention pruning.

paper.title: RepFusion: Leveraging Multimodal Priors for Denoising in Representation Space
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used in text-to-image (T2I) systems, but they are typically limited to text encoding, while denoising is handled by newly trained generative backbones. The emergence of representation autoencoders (RAEs) shifts the generation target toward semantically structured visual representations, creating a latent space that is more compatible with pretrained LLM priors. Inspired by multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), where an MLP projector is sufficient to align clean visual

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像生成中，如何把预训练多模态/语言模型的表征先验真正用于去噪主干，而不只停留在文本编码侧的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成方法创新：它尝试把 MLLM 从条件编码器扩展为噪声表征编码器，检验预训练语义表征是否能替代部分新训练 denoiser 容量。对统一建模和跨模态预训练有间接启发，但不是 LLM 预训练核心论文。
summary.technical_approach: 论文建立在 representation autoencoder 设定上，把生成目标从像素 latent 转到更语义化的视觉表征空间；受 MLLM 中 projector 对齐 clean visual representation 的启发，作者将 MLLM 直接复用为 noisy representation encoder，再把其输出作为 diffusion transformer 的条件信号。核心主张是：预训练 MLLM 已含有足够强的多模态先验，可在 denoising 阶段继续发挥作用，而不必完全依赖新初始化的去噪网络学习。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在相近推理预算下，RepFusion 优于把相当容量分配给新初始化 denoiser 的基线；但未给出模型参数、训练数据规模、具体 FID/GenEval 等指标幅度。可读性主要取决于正文是否做了干净的 capacity matching 和 inference-budget matching。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Saining Xie，通常与 NYU/FAIR 体系的视觉与生成建模工作相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to use pretrained multimodal/LLM priors for the denoising stage of text-to-image generation, rather than limiting them to text encoding.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method paper. Its main value is testing whether pretrained semantic priors from MLLMs can substitute for part of a newly trained denoiser. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it does touch unified representation learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on representation autoencoders, the method shifts the generation target toward semantically structured visual representations. Inspired by the fact that MLLMs can align clean visual representations with a lightweight projector, the paper repurposes the MLLM itself as a noisy representation encoder and feeds its outputs as conditioning into a diffusion transformer. The core claim is that pretrained MLLMs carry denoising-relevant priors, not just text-conditioning priors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains over baselines that allocate similar capacity to newly initialized denoisers under comparable inference budgets, but gives no model sizes, data scale, or exact metric improvements. The paper is worth checking only if the capacity and budget matching are clean.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Saining Xie, typically associated with strong vision and generative modeling work from the NYU/FAIR ecosystem.

recommendation.zh: 对做统一预训练的人有一点味道：看它是否真把“预训练表征可做去噪器”做成了 clean ablation；若 capacity match 不严，这个结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Mildly interesting for unified pretraining: check whether the paper cleanly shows pretrained representations can act as denoisers; if the capacity matching is loose, treat the claim as weak evidence.

paper.title: GF-DiT: Scheduling Parallelism for Diffusion Transformer Serving
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for image and video generation, creating growing demand for efficient DiT serving. Existing systems assign each request a fixed parallel configuration throughout its lifetime. However, DiT workloads exhibit substantial heterogeneity across requests, execution stages, and system conditions, making static parallelism inefficient and often leading to poor GPU utilization and degraded service quality.   This paper argues that DiT se

summary.core_problem: 如何解决 Diffusion Transformer (DiT) 推理服务中因请求异构性导致的静态并行策略效率低下的问题？
summary.importance: 针对 DiT 架构提出了动态并行调度系统，提升了 GPU 利用率和服务质量，对多模态生成模型的部署有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GF-DiT，一个支持策略编程的弹性 DiT 服务运行时。它将请求分解为独立调度的轨迹任务（trajectory tasks），实现异步执行和在线 GPU 重新分配。为了使弹性并行实用化，还提出了无组（group-free）的并行机制。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中提供具体实验数据，但强调了解决 GPU 利用率低和服务质量下降的问题。
summary.authors_note: 上海交通大学团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to address the inefficiency of static parallelism strategies in Diffusion Transformer (DiT) serving caused by request heterogeneity?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a dynamic parallel scheduling system for the DiT architecture, improving GPU utilization and service quality, providing engineering reference value for the deployment of multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents GF-DiT, a policy-programmable runtime for elastic DiT serving. It decomposes requests into independently schedulable trajectory tasks, enabling asynchronous execution and online GPU reallocation. To make elastic parallelism practical, it also proposes a group-free parallelism mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental data is not provided in the abstract, but it emphasizes solving the problems of low GPU utilization and degraded service quality.
summary_en.authors_note: Work by a team from Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: DiT 推理系统的工程优化，关注 Serving 效率的同学可作为 literature 备查，不涉及预训练核心机制。
recommendation.en: Engineering optimization for DiT serving systems. Good as literature reference for those focusing on serving efficiency, but does not involve core pre-training mechanisms.

paper.title: OmniDirector: General Multi-Shot Camera Cloning without Cross-Paired Data
paper.abstract: Cloning camera motion from reference videos is an important task in video generation, as videos provide intuitive and precise control. Existing methods either directly use parametric representations that fail to handle multi-shot generation or synthesize cross-paired data, which suffer from data scarcity, resulting in poor performance in complicated camera motion cloning. To address these issues, we introduce a general camera motion representation that encodes cameras as grid motion videos. This

summary.core_problem: 在缺少cross-paired训练数据的情况下，实现多镜头(multi-shot)视频生成中的相机运动克隆与可控导演式控制。
summary.importance: 属于视频生成控制与表示学习；对“可控生成/控制信号表示”有启发，但对LLM基座预训练的直接方法论贡献有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出将相机参数“可视化”为grid motion video的通用相机运动表示，支持多镜头轨迹组合；在此之上训练统一框架OmniDirector（面向多模态diffusion transformer的角色/动作/相机协同控制）；并用层级prompt扩展agent融合多种控制信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要仅提到使用million-scale camera grid-video pairs训练；未给出具体模型规模、基线、定量指标与提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: General multi-shot camera motion cloning for video generation without cross-paired training data.
summary_en.importance: Primarily about controllable video generation and control-signal representations; only indirect relevance to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Represents camera parameters as a visualized grid-motion video to enable multi-shot trajectory composition; trains a unified OmniDirector framework for multimodal diffusion transformers to coordinate character/action/camera control; adds a hierarchical prompt-expansion agent to integrate control signals.
summary_en.experiments: Mentions training on million-scale camera grid–video pairs, but lacks model size, baselines, metrics, and quantitative gains in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只建议看“camera grid 表示”这一点：把控制变量token化/可视化的思路可迁移到统一建模，其余更像视频生成工程。
recommendation.en: Skim only the “camera grid” representation idea (control-variable tokenization); the rest reads like video-gen engineering.

paper.title: UniVoice: A Unified Model for Speech and Singing Voice Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-speech (TTS) and singing voice synthesis (SVS) both aim to generate human vocal audio from symbolic inputs, but they impose different requirements on the generation process. Speech generation relies on flexible, language-driven prosody, whereas singing generation requires explicit melody control and accurate rhythmic alignment. This mismatch makes it challenging to train a single model that can generate both natural speech and controllable singing, since melody-related conditions should

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作试图用一个统一模型同时完成语音生成和歌声生成，解决两者在韵律自由度与旋律强约束之间的冲突。
summary.importance: 它属于语音生成方向的方法整合。对 LLM 基座研究员的价值不在 TTS 本身，而在条件因子分解和共享生成骨干的设计：内容、旋律、音色被拆开编码，再送入统一 DiT，这和多模态统一建模里的条件解耦思路相通。
summary.technical_approach: UniVoice 基于 conditional flow matching。作者不使用单一混合条件表示，而是把条件分解为 content、melody、timbre 三部分，分别用适合模态的编码器建模，再由共享的 Diffusion Transformer 生成音频。歌声侧用 MIDI note sequence 提供旋律控制；语音侧则不让 melody 条件过度约束 prosody，从而兼顾 speech 的自然性与 singing 的可控性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练语料规模和具体 baseline。实验目标应是同时验证 speech 与 singing 两个任务上的自然度、可控性和统一建模能力。由于缺少离散 tokenizer、统一 token space 或语言建模式建模细节，这篇更偏生成系统设计，而不是 AudioLM/VALL-E 那类对基座预训练更直接的工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to build a single model for both speech generation and singing voice generation, addressing the mismatch between flexible speech prosody and strongly constrained melody control in singing.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a speech-generation unification paper. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is not TTS per se, but the factorized conditioning design: content, melody, and timbre are encoded separately and fed into a shared DiT backbone, which echoes broader ideas in unified multimodal modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniVoice is based on conditional flow matching. Instead of a single undifferentiated conditioning representation, it factorizes conditions into content, melody, and timbre, each handled by a modality-appropriate encoder and consumed by a shared Diffusion Transformer. For singing, melody is represented by MIDI note sequences; for speech, melody should not overconstrain prosody, allowing natural speech generation while preserving singing controllability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, or exact baselines. The likely evaluation targets are naturalness, controllability, and unified performance across both speech and singing. Because the paper does not appear to center on discrete tokenization, unified token spaces, or language-model-style audio modeling, it is more of a generation-system design than an AudioLM/VALL-E-style foundation-model contribution.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心统一生成条件接口，可以看它怎么拆 content/melody/timbre；但它离“把语音当 LM 建”还远，正文不必细读。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for how it factorizes content, melody, and timbre in a shared generator, but it is still far from the 'audio as LM' line, so no need to read deeply.

paper.title: SlotMemory: Object-Centric KV Memory for Streaming Long-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Streaming video generation models typically rely on temporal-centric memory, which organizes historical context as raw frames, chunk segments, or unclustered tokens. This organization frequently leads to identity drift and semantic inconsistency when entities exit the frame or during interactive prompt transitions. To address these limitations, we propose SlotMemory, an object-centric Key-Value memory mechanism for streaming video diffusion. Our approach shifts the memory abstraction from "when"

summary.core_problem: 长视频流式生成中的历史记忆通常按时间组织，例如原始帧、片段或未聚类 token。这样做在角色离开局部窗口后再出现、或多 prompt 交互切换时，容易出现身份漂移、道具丢失和语义不连续。SlotMemory 试图把记忆单元从“什么时候出现过”改成“表示哪个对象或语义实体”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在长程多模态生成的记忆表示，而不是纯文本 LLM 训练 recipe。它说明单纯扩大 temporal context 或保存更多 KV，并不一定解决长程一致性；更关键的是记忆索引的语义结构。这个思路对 video-native LM、AR+diffusion 统一建模、长上下文多模态模型都有参考价值：KV-cache 不只可以是顺序缓存，也可以被组织成可复用的实体级记忆。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在视频 diffusion transformer 中加入 object-centric KV memory。它用 slot-based representation learning 将 transformer 的 KV manifold 分解成离散语义 slot。slot 不直接替代原始 KV，而是作为路由地址，用来索引和存储高保真的 transformer-compatible KV tokens。这样既保留 diffusion 生成需要的细节，又给历史信息加上实体级索引。系统包含递归的 read-write-update 流程：写入阶段用 temporally-initialized Slot Attention 把当前上下文划分到不同语义区域；读取阶段根据 slot 检索相关 KV；更新和淘汰阶段用 prompt-aware scoring 同时考虑文本对齐和视觉相关性，从而在 prompt 切换时保留核心实体、丢弃过时的短期运动上下文。它和普通滑窗或 chunk memory 的差别在于，后者按时间衰减，SlotMemory 按语义身份复用。
summary.experiments: 实验以 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 为 backbone，评估长视频和 60 秒交互式多 prompt 生成。报告中的关键数字包括：interactive narratives quality score 达到 81.61；30 秒 horizon 的 dynamic score 为 74.29，相比已有 streaming 方法有 22.8% 相对提升。论文强调的主要收益是减少 60 秒 rollout 中的累计 feature drift，尤其是角色离开画面后重新出现、场景切换后恢复关键道具、以及多阶段 prompt 中保持实体身份。消融的核心应围绕 slot memory、prompt-aware retrieval、eviction/update 逻辑和纯 temporal memory 的对比来理解。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分和实验可视化，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，slot 如何从 transformer KV 表示中产生，而不是从像素或显式检测框产生；第二，prompt-aware scoring 如何决定保留和淘汰，这决定它能否处理交互式 prompt 切换；第三，60 秒案例中的失败模式对比，尤其是 identity drift 和 re-entry consistency。对 LLM 研究员来说，不必细读视频生成细节，应该关注“语义索引的 KV memory”是否能迁移到长上下文、多实体对话、多模态 agent memory。

summary_en.core_problem: Streaming long-video generation usually stores history as frames, chunks, or unclustered tokens. This time-centric memory breaks down when an entity leaves the local window and later re-enters, or when the prompt changes across an interactive narrative. SlotMemory reframes the memory unit from temporal occurrence to semantic identity.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is long-horizon multimodal memory design, not text-only pretraining. The paper argues that increasing temporal capacity or retaining more KV tokens is insufficient if the memory has no semantic structure. For native video LMs, unified AR-diffusion systems, and long-context multimodal models, the useful idea is that KV memory can be organized around reusable entities rather than stored as a flat sequence.
summary_en.technical_approach: SlotMemory inserts an object-centric KV memory into a video diffusion transformer. It decomposes the transformer's KV manifold into discrete semantic slots using slot-based representation learning. These slots do not replace the original KV tokens; they serve as routing addresses for indexing and retrieving high-fidelity transformer-compatible KV tokens. The system follows a recursive read-write-update pipeline. During writing, temporally initialized Slot Attention partitions the current transformer states into semantic regions. During reading, the model retrieves KV tokens through slot addresses. During update and eviction, a prompt-aware scoring function balances text alignment and visual relevance, allowing persistent entities to survive prompt transitions while obsolete motion context is removed. This differs from sliding-window or chunk memory, where retention is mainly controlled by temporal distance.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B as the backbone and include long-form generation plus a 60-second interactive multi-prompt setting. Reported numbers include an interactive narrative quality score of 81.61 and a 30-second dynamic score of 74.29, corresponding to a 22.8% relative improvement over the compared streaming baseline. The qualitative results focus on reduced feature drift over 60-second rollouts, especially identity preservation after re-entry, persistent props across scene changes, and entity consistency under prompt transitions. The most informative ablations are expected to isolate slot memory, prompt-aware retrieval, and eviction/update logic against purely temporal memory.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Focus on how slots are derived from transformer KV states rather than pixels or detector outputs, how prompt-aware scoring decides retention and eviction, and how the 60-second visual comparisons expose identity drift and re-entry failures. For LLM researchers, the key point is not the video diffusion implementation itself, but whether semantic KV indexing can transfer to long-context dialogue, multi-entity multimodal memory, or agent memory.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 预训练论文，但 object-centric KV routing 值得扫 Fig/方法；可作为长程记忆设计的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM pretraining paper, but the object-centric KV routing is worth skimming as a weak signal for long-horizon memory design.

paper.title: SANA-Streaming: Real-time Streaming Video Editing with Hybrid Diffusion Transformer
paper.abstract: Real-time streaming video-to-video editing (V2V) is critical for interactive applications such as live broadcasting and gaming, yet it remains a formidable challenge due to the stringent requirements for temporal consistency and inference throughput. In this paper, we present SANA-Streaming, a system-algorithm co-designed framework for high-resolution, real-time streaming video editing on consumer GPUs, with the following three core designs: (1) Hybrid Diffusion Transformer architecture introduc

summary.core_problem: 实时流视频到视频编辑需要同时满足高时间一致性和高推理吞吐量，现有视频扩散模型难以在消费级GPU上实现。
summary.importance: 系统与算法协同设计的实时视频编辑框架，结合混合Diffusion Transformer架构、循环反向正则化和GPU系统优化。
summary.technical_approach: 混合Diffusion Transformer在部分块中引入softmax注意力以改善局部建模同时保持线性层效率；循环反向正则化通过flow matching从生成内容预测源帧来强制语义一致性；系统层融合GDN核与混合精度量化。
summary.experiments: 在消费级NVIDIA GPU上实现高分辨率实时流视频编辑，验证了三个核心设计的有效性。
summary.authors_note: Song Han团队（MIT），知名于高效深度学习系统设计，代表性工作包括剪枝、量化、Deep Compression。

summary_en.core_problem: Real-time streaming video-to-video editing requires both high temporal consistency and high inference throughput, which existing video diffusion models cannot deliver on consumer GPUs.
summary_en.importance: System-algorithm co-designed real-time video editing framework combining hybrid Diffusion Transformer architecture, cycle-reverse regularization, and GPU system optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hybrid Diffusion Transformer introduces softmax attention in some blocks for better local modeling while preserving linear-layer efficiency; Cycle-Reverse Regularization enforces semantic consistency by predicting source frames from generated content via flow matching; system-level fused GDN kernels + Mixed-Precision Quantization.
summary_en.experiments: High-resolution real-time streaming video editing on consumer NVIDIA GPUs; validates the three core design components.
summary_en.authors_note: Song Han's group (MIT), known for efficient deep learning systems (Deep Compression, pruning, quantization).

recommendation.zh: 视频生成与实时推理优化结合不错，但与LLM预训练核心问题较远，作为前沿跟踪备查。
recommendation.en: Interesting combination of video generation and real-time inference optimization but peripheral to LLM pretraining; track as frontier reference.

paper.title: Orthogonal Negative Guidance in Attention Feature Space for Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have become increasingly capable of generating high-quality images. Yet, enforcing the explicit absence of a specified object or attribute remains a fundamentally challenging problem. Existing approaches, including prompt negation, post-hoc editing, and negative guidance, remain insufficient for explicit concept suppression, often failing to remove the target concept or degrading overall image quality. To this end, we propose Orthogonal Negative Guidance in attention f

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图模型难以明确“不要生成某个物体或属性”的问题，同时避免负向提示破坏整体图像质量和语义对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型推理控制方法：在 MM-DiT 文生图 transformer 的 attention feature space 中做训练免费负向引导。对预训练研究的价值有限，但对理解 diffusion transformer 中条件特征的可操作性有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 negative prompt 的 attention output 特征相对 positive prompt 特征做正交化，只减去与正向语义正交的负向成分；这样试图压制不想要的概念，同时保留正向 prompt 的语义和图像质量。属于训练免费 inference-time guidance。
summary.experiments: 实验在 FLUX-dev 和 FLUX-schnell 上进行，比较概念抑制、prompt alignment 和图像质量的 trade-off；摘要提到 human evaluation 显示更好的权衡，但未提供具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses explicit concept suppression in text-to-image generation: making a model avoid a specified object or attribute without degrading the desired image content.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time control method for generative models. It operates in the attention feature space of MM-DiT text-to-image transformers. It is not a pretraining paper, but it offers a useful view of how conditional features can be manipulated inside diffusion transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Orthogonal Negative Guidance orthogonalizes negative-prompt attention features against positive-prompt features and subtracts only the orthogonal component. This is meant to remove unwanted concepts while preserving positive-prompt semantics, with no additional training.
summary_en.experiments: The method is tested on FLUX-dev and FLUX-schnell. The evaluation focuses on the trade-off among concept suppression, prompt alignment, and image quality, with human evaluation mentioned but no detailed numbers in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和特征正交化设定；这是推理期控制技巧，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and feature-orthogonalization setup; this is an inference-time control trick, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: SoftCap: Soft-Budget Control for Diffusion Transformer Acceleration
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve strong visual quality, but their iterative denoising process requires many costly Transformer evaluations. Training-free acceleration methods reduce this cost by caching, forecasting, or verifying intermediate features, yet the runtime decision of when to execute a Full step is often driven by fixed schedules or hand-tuned thresholds. We propose \textbf{SoftCap}, a training-free control layer for cache-based DiT inference. SoftCap couples a Trajectory Drift

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散Transformer（DiT）的免训练推理加速方法依赖固定调度或人工调优阈值触发全步计算，无法在给定计算预算下平衡速度与生成质量
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出免训练的软预算控制机制，为迭代生成模型的动态推理调度提供了可迁移的设计思路
summary.technical_approach: 原创方法，包含两个核心模块：轨迹漂移观测器通过轻量隐状态统计估计缓存风险，软预算PI控制器根据实际计算消耗相对于参考配置动态调整全步触发阈值，预算为软上限而非强制固定全步数
summary.experiments: 在FLUX.1-dev模型上测试，同计算量级下相比SpeCa方法，ImageReward从0.967提升至0.981，原文摘要截断，完整延迟优化数据未给出

summary_en.core_problem: Existing training-free acceleration methods for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) rely on fixed schedules or hand-tuned thresholds to trigger full-step computation, failing to balance speed and generation quality under a given compute budget
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a training-free soft-budget control mechanism that provides transferable design insights for dynamic inference scheduling of iterative generative models
summary_en.technical_approach: Original method with two core modules: a Trajectory Drift Observer estimates cache risk via lightweight hidden-state statistics, and a Soft-Budget PI Controller dynamically adjusts the full-step triggering threshold based on actual compute consumption relative to a reference profile, with the budget acting as a soft ceiling instead of a mandatory fixed number of full steps
summary_en.experiments: Tested on FLUX.1-dev, improves ImageReward from 0.967 to 0.981 over SpeCa at a comparable compute level, the abstract is truncated and full latency optimization data is not provided

recommendation.zh: 软预算控制的动态调度思路可迁移至扩散LM推理优化，无需读全文，重点看核心方法设计即可
recommendation.en: The dynamic scheduling idea of soft-budget control is transferable to diffusion LM inference acceleration, no need to read the full paper, just check the core method design

paper.title: LoSATok: Low-dimensional Semantic-Acoustic Tokenizer for Cross-Domain Audio Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: Audio tokenizers are fundamental to unifying audio understanding and generation. Understanding requires high-level semantics, while generation demands semantic and acoustic details. Existing unified tokenizers jointly encode both in high-dimensional continuous latents, which increases the modeling burden of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) for generation. We propose LoSATok, a low-dimensional audio tokenizer for cross-domain audio understanding and generation. Motivated by the observation that 1280

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决统一音频理解与生成中的表示维度问题：高维语义表示有利于理解和生成条件建模，但会增加 DiT 生成器负担；纯声学 token 又缺少高层语义。目标是学习一个低维、语义强、可重建声学细节的音频表示。
summary.importance: 这篇论文与跨模态统一预训练和音频 LM 方向相关。它的价值不在某个下游音频任务，而在 tokenizer 设计：把语义压缩、声学重建和生成器建模成本放在同一个目标里优化。对预训练研究的启发是，tokenizer 的维度不是工程细节，而会直接改变后续 DiT 或 LM 的优化难度、参数需求和收敛速度。128 维连续 latent 如果能保留足够语义和声学信息，会让统一音频建模更接近可扩展训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析 MiDashengLM 的高维语义特征，发现方差集中在少数主方向，effective rank 和 PCA 结果表明语义信息可被压缩到 128 维。直接 PCA 或通道合并虽然能保留部分语义，但没有针对时间结构优化。为此论文提出 Semantic Bottleneck。它冻结预训练语义 encoder，用 compressor 将高维语义特征投影到低维空间，再用 restorer 重建高维特征；训练时同时使用高维重建损失和 time-relation loss。time-relation loss 类似 Gram 关系约束，目标是保留不同时间帧之间的语义关系，而不只是逐帧拟合数值。基于这个低维语义信号，LoSATok 引入 dual-level semantic supervision：高维语义监督提供完整目标，低维语义监督提供紧凑目标，同时注入声学信号，使 tokenizer 同时具备语义理解和声学重建能力。与高维 unified tokenizer 相比，它减少下游 DiT 的建模负担；与纯 acoustic tokenizer 相比，它给生成模型提供更语义化的 latent 空间。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 speech、music 和 general audio。理解侧在 15 个跨域任务上评估，LoSATok 的 128 维表示达到与多种 SSL 表示相近的平均结果，并优于 HuBERT、WavLM 等若干基线。生成侧把 LoSATok 接入 DiT，用于 text-to-audio、text-to-music 和 text-to-speech。论文报告称，相比高维 unified tokenizer，LoSATok 在相同或更小 DiT 配置下取得更好的生成效果；相比 acoustic tokenizer，它收敛更快，并且在较小 DiT hidden dimension 下表现更好。提供内容没有列出具体表格数值，因此关键实验结论应理解为维度压缩带来的建模效率提升，以及双层语义监督对理解和生成两侧的共同收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30–40 分钟。优先看三部分：第一，高维语义特征的 redundancy / effective rank / PCA 分析，这决定 128 维设定是否可信；第二，Semantic Bottleneck 和 time-relation loss 的公式，尤其是它如何约束时间帧关系；第三，生成实验中 DiT 宽度、参数量和收敛速度的对比。若时间有限，可以跳过具体音频下游任务细节，重点看 tokenizer 训练目标和 latent 维度对生成器成本的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the representation bottleneck in unified audio understanding and generation. High-dimensional semantic features are useful but expensive for DiT-based generation, while purely acoustic tokens lack high-level semantics. The goal is a low-dimensional audio representation that remains semantically rich and acoustically reconstructable.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to multimodal pretraining and audio language modeling through tokenizer design. Its main contribution is to optimize semantic compression, acoustic reconstruction, and downstream generative modeling cost together. For pretraining research, the useful lesson is that tokenizer dimensionality directly affects optimization difficulty, model width requirements, and convergence behavior in the generator.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first analyze high-dimensional semantic features from MiDashengLM and find a low-rank structure: variance is concentrated in a subset of principal directions, and PCA/effective-rank analyses suggest that much of the semantic content can be retained at 128 dimensions. However, training-free PCA or channel merging does not optimize temporal structure. The proposed Semantic Bottleneck freezes a pretrained semantic encoder, compresses its high-dimensional features into a low-dimensional space, and reconstructs the original features through a restorer. Training uses both high-dimensional reconstruction and a time-relation loss, which preserves semantic relations across temporal frames rather than only matching frame-wise values. LoSATok then builds a unified semantic-acoustic tokenizer with dual-level semantic supervision: high-dimensional semantic targets provide complete semantic guidance, while low-dimensional targets provide a compact direct signal. Acoustic information is injected so that the latent can support both understanding and waveform-oriented generation.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers speech, music, and general audio. On the understanding side, LoSATok is tested on 15 cross-domain tasks and is reported to achieve average performance comparable to several self-supervised audio representations, outperforming baselines such as HuBERT and WavLM in some comparisons. On the generation side, the tokenizer is used with a DiT generator for text-to-audio, text-to-music, and text-to-speech. The reported result is that LoSATok performs better than high-dimensional unified tokenizers under the same or smaller DiT settings, and converges faster than acoustic tokenizers, especially when the DiT hidden dimension is small. The provided text does not include exact tables, so the main reliable takeaway is the efficiency gain from low-dimensional semantic-acoustic latents.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–40 minutes. Read the redundancy analysis of high-dimensional semantic features first, especially effective rank and PCA evidence. Then inspect the Semantic Bottleneck objective and the time-relation loss, since that is the main modeling contribution. Finally, check the generation experiments where DiT width, parameter count, and convergence speed are compared. The detailed downstream audio task setup is less central than the tokenizer objective and its effect on generator cost.

recommendation.zh: 低维tokenizer的压缩思路与时序一致性损失设计可迁移到多模态统一tokenizer的预训练 ablation，重点看§3的监督与损失设计
recommendation.en: The low-dimensional token compression scheme and temporal consistency loss can be migrated to multimodal unified tokenizer pretraining ablations; focus on Section 3 supervision design

paper.title: RT-Lynx: Putting the GEMM Sparsity In a Right Way for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve strong performance in image generation but incur substantial inference costs. While prior work has reduced this cost via quantization and distillation, semi-structured sparsity, which can nearly halve FLOPs, remains underexplored. A key reason is that most existing approaches focus on weight sparsification, and pruning 50% of the weights can remove critical model capacity and degrade generation quality. Our study, however, shows that DiT activations are intri

summary.core_problem: 降低 Diffusion Transformer 图像生成推理中 GEMM 的计算成本，同时避免权重剪枝带来的生成质量损失。
summary.importance: 这是 DiT 推理加速工作，贡献在于把 N:M semi-structured sparsity 的重点从权重转向 activation，并配套 CUDA kernel。它对 LLM 预训练不直接相关，但 activation sparsity 的测量和 kernel 设计对大模型推理系统有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RT-Lynx 观察到 DiT activation 天然更稀疏，且比权重更能承受 N:M semi-structured sparsification。方法在 activation 上施加 N:M 稀疏化，并加入 error compensation 减少精度损失，同时实现针对该模式优化的 CUDA kernel。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是图像生成中的 Diffusion Transformer。摘要报告其在线性层平均最高达到 1.55 倍加速；具体模型规模、数据集、FID 或人评指标、baseline 细节在所给摘要中未完整列出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets GEMM cost reduction for Diffusion Transformer image generation while avoiding the quality loss caused by weight sparsification.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-acceleration paper for DiTs. Its contribution is to shift N:M semi-structured sparsity from weights to activations and to provide matching CUDA kernels. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the activation-sparsity measurement and kernel design are relevant to large-model serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: RT-Lynx argues that DiT activations are intrinsically sparse and more robust to N:M semi-structured sparsification than weights. It applies N:M sparsity to activations, adds error-compensation techniques to reduce quality loss, and implements optimized CUDA kernels for the resulting sparse GEMM pattern.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are on Diffusion Transformers for image generation. The abstract reports up to 1.55x average speedup in linear layers; the provided text does not include complete model sizes, datasets, generation metrics, or baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 作为效率信号看 activation 稀疏性即可；生成模型结论不能直接外推到 LLM，但 kernel 思路可备查。
recommendation.en: Use it as an activation-sparsity signal; the DiT result does not transfer directly to LLMs, but the kernel idea is worth filing.

paper.title: Where Concept Erasure Should Occur: Concept-Layer Alignment in Text-to-Video Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Text-to-video diffusion transformers encode semantic information unevenly across model depth, which constrains effective concept erasure. We identify a representational bottleneck, termed concept-layer topological alignment, under which target concepts exhibit higher separability at certain representational depths. Outside these depths, concept and non-target signals remain strongly entangled, limiting the effectiveness of depth-specific erasure. This observation reframes concept erasure as the

summary.core_problem: 在文本到视频 diffusion transformer 中，概念擦除应该发生在哪些网络层，才能删除目标概念同时少伤害非目标内容。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成模型安全编辑与表示分析方法。它把概念擦除从层无关或经验选层，改成基于概念可分性的层选择问题；对理解 diffusion transformer 的层间语义分布有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 concept-layer topological alignment：目标概念只在部分深度上具有更高可分性，其他层中目标与非目标信号纠缠。CLEAR 将选层表述为优化目标，寻找概念与非目标表示自然分离的层，再在这些层上施加擦除约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有暴露具体 T2V backbone、数据集、概念集合或定量结果。实验主张是基于层可分性选择擦除位置，比层无关或启发式层选择更能兼顾擦除和保真。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which layers in text-to-video diffusion transformers should be edited for concept erasure so that target concepts are removed while non-target content is preserved.
summary_en.importance: This is a safety-editing and representation-analysis contribution for generative video models. It reframes concept erasure from layer-agnostic or heuristic editing into a separability-driven layer selection problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key hypothesis is concept-layer topological alignment: target concepts become more separable only at certain representational depths, while other layers entangle target and non-target signals. CLEAR optimizes layer selection using concept-vs-non-target separability and applies erasure where separation naturally emerges.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not reveal the exact T2V backbones, datasets, concept sets, or numerical results. The reported claim is that separability-driven erasure outperforms layer-agnostic or heuristic choices in balancing removal and preservation.

recommendation.zh: 不必精读结果，概念只在少数层可分这个判断可记下；它可能迁移到 VLM 安全编辑和表征探针。
recommendation.en: Do not over-read the metrics; the useful prior is that concept separability may be localized to a few layers.

paper.title: Blocked Gibbs meets Diffusion Transformers: Unsupervised Learning for Constraint Optimization
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have shown promise in learning to solve constraint optimization problems. However, they are mostly restricted to problems with binary variables and rely on graph neural networks, hindering their application to a broader range of problems such as those with general discrete variables or constraint structures that necessitate global rather than local reasoning. We investigate the use of Diffusion Transformers to address the aforementioned limitations. A naive implementation perfor

summary.core_problem: 标准 diffusion Transformer 用于约束优化时，逐步、全变量的小幅去噪和约束求解中需要局部大幅重写变量的需求不匹配。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是建模机制改造。它不是语言模型论文，但把 blocked Gibbs sampling 的局部重采样思想接到 Diffusion Transformer 上，对离散结构生成和约束满足型生成任务有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Blocked Gibbs Diffusion Transformer，核心是用 blocked Gaussian denoising 替代标准 joint Gaussian denoising。模型每次选择变量块进行重采样，而不是对所有变量同步做小步去噪，以更贴近组合优化中修复不可行解或改进目标值的过程。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明方法面向一般离散变量和需要全局推理的约束结构，并声称 naive Diffusion Transformer 表现较差；未提供具体任务、模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 数字或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the mismatch between standard diffusion denoising and constraint optimization, where feasible or better solutions often require large updates to selected variable subsets.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a modeling change rather than an LLM result. It is relevant mainly as a signal for diffusion-style generation over structured discrete spaces, especially where local repairs matter more than uniform small denoising steps.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Blocked Gibbs Diffusion Transformer replaces joint Gaussian denoising with blocked Gaussian denoising. Instead of denoising all variables at once, the model iteratively resamples blocks of variables, borrowing the update pattern of blocked Gibbs methods.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that naive Diffusion Transformers underperform on this setting and that the method is intended for general discrete variables and non-local constraint structures. It does not expose model size, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 blocked denoising 的动机即可；离 diffusion LM 还有距离，但这个 mismatch 判断值得记下。
recommendation.en: Skim only the blocked-denoising motivation; it is far from diffusion LMs, but the mismatch diagnosis is worth keeping.

paper.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a dominant architecture for text-to-image generation, yet their performance drops when generating at resolutions beyond their training range. Existing training-free approaches mitigate this by modifying inference-time attention behavior, often through Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) extrapolation combined with attention scaling. However, these strategies apply a uniform and content-agnostic scaling across RoPE components with distinct frequency cha

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像 Diffusion Transformer 在超出训练分辨率生成时结构一致性和细节质量下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成推理阶段的训练-free 分辨率外推方法。它不直接改变预训练 recipe，但对使用 RoPE 的生成式 Transformer 在位置外推时的频率分量处理有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SEGA，即 Spectral-Energy Guided Attention。与统一缩放 RoPE attention 不同，SEGA 根据每个 denoising step 中 latent 的空间频率结构，对不同 RoPE 频率成分做动态缩放，试图同时保留全局结构和恢复高频细节。
summary.experiments: 在多个目标高分辨率设置上测试，报告相比已有训练-free 高分辨率合成方法有稳定改进；摘要未说明所用 DiT 模型、数据集、分辨率范围、指标和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Toronto 和 Vector Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses resolution extrapolation for text-to-image Diffusion Transformers, where image quality drops when generation resolution exceeds the training range.
summary_en.importance: It is a training-free inference method for multimodal generation. While not a pretraining recipe, it is relevant to how RoPE-based generative Transformers handle positional extrapolation and frequency-specific attention behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: SEGA dynamically scales attention across RoPE components according to the latent spatial-frequency structure at each denoising step. This contrasts with uniform, content-agnostic RoPE scaling and aims to preserve both global structure and fine details.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent improvements across multiple high-resolution targets over existing training-free extrapolation methods, but does not specify the DiT models, datasets, resolution ranges, metrics, or exact margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Toronto and Vector Institute.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RoPE 频率分量分析；这是图像生成推理补丁，但对位置外推的频域 failure mode 有参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the RoPE frequency analysis; it is an image-generation inference patch, but the extrapolation failure mode is useful.

paper.title: Rethinking Cross-Layer Information Routing in Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a de facto backbone of modern visual generation, and nearly every major axis of their design -- tokenization, attention, conditioning, objectives, and latent autoencoders -- has been extensively revisited. The residual stream that governs how information accumulates across layers, however, has been directly inherited from the original Transformer. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical analysis of cross-layer information flow in DiTs, jointly a

summary.core_problem: 分析 Diffusion Transformer 中传统 residual addition 是否适合跨层信息路由，并尝试替换残差流的累积方式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视觉生成模型的架构分析和改进。它把注意力、tokenizer、conditioning 之外较少被系统研究的 residual stream 拿出来分析，对理解深层 DiT 的训练动态有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先沿模型深度和 denoising timestep 分析 DiT 的跨层信息流，指出传统残差加法会带来前向幅度单调膨胀、反向梯度快速衰减、block-wise redundancy。随后提出 Diffusion-Adaptive Routing，作为 drop-in residual replacement，对历史 sublayer outputs 做可学习、timestep-adaptive、非增量式聚合。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。它声称 DAR 与多种现代 Transformer/DiT 设计兼容，但具体实验细节需看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether standard residual addition is the right cross-layer routing mechanism for Diffusion Transformers and proposes an alternative.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architectural diagnosis and modification for visual generative DiTs. It focuses on the residual stream, a component less frequently revisited than tokenization, attention, conditioning, objectives, or latent autoencoders.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze information flow across both depth and denoising timesteps, identifying forward magnitude inflation, backward gradient decay, and block-wise redundancy under standard residual addition. They introduce Diffusion-Adaptive Routing, a drop-in replacement that performs learnable, timestep-adaptive, non-incremental aggregation over historical sublayer outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model scale, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims compatibility with modern Transformer and DiT variants, with details requiring the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 对 LLM 不是主线；扫 residual/gradient 诊断图即可，DAR 是否迁移到文本模型还需要重做实验。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper; skim the residual and gradient diagnostics, but any transfer to text models needs fresh ablations.

paper.title: Rethinking Cross-Layer Information Routing in Diffusion Transformers

The residual stream that governs how information accumulates across layers, however, has been directly inherited from the original Transformer. summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 DiT 中跨层信息如何流动。问题不在 attention、tokenizer 或 diffusion objective，而在 Transformer 继承来的 PreNorm residual stream：逐层残差相加会在 DiT 的深度维度和 denoising timestep 维度上造成表示幅值膨胀、梯度衰减和层间冗余。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏架构诊断和改造的工作，对 LLM 基座研究也有参考价值。它把 LLM 中讨论过的 PreNorm dilution 现象放到 diffusion transformer 里重新审视，并指出 DiT 多了一个关键变量：噪声时间步。高噪声阶段更依赖粗结构，低噪声阶段更依赖细节，固定的逐层相加不一定适合这种动态过程。这个观察对统一多模态预训练也有启发，因为 AR Transformer 的残差习惯设计在 diffusion / flow / masked 生成模型中未必仍是合适默认项。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先做诊断：沿网络深度和 denoising timestep 分析 hidden-state magnitude、反向梯度和 block-wise redundancy，发现传统 residual addition 带来三类同步出现的问题。随后提出 Diffusion-Adaptive Routing，简称 DAR。DAR 用一个沿深度维度的可学习路由替代固定残差累加：每个子层不再简单接收 running residual，而是对之前子层输出做 softmax attention 聚合。query 来自当前经过 adaLN 调制的 hidden state，因此路由同时依赖内容和 timestep 条件。这个设计区别于 U-Net 式长 skip connection：它不手工指定浅层和深层配对，也不强行恢复固定层级结构，而是在保持 isotropic Transformer stack 的同时做 timestep-adaptive、non-incremental 的跨层聚合。DAR 也可以和 REPA 这类 representation-alignment objective 叠加。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 ImageNet 256×256 上进行。以 SiT-XL/2 为例，DAR 达到 7.56 FID，相比 matched compute 的 vanilla SiT 降低 2.11 FID。训练效率上，DAR 用约 8.75× 更少的训练迭代达到 baseline 的收敛质量。与 REPA 结合时，早期训练相对单独 REPA 还有约 2× 加速。论文还把性能提升和诊断指标联系起来：forward magnitude inflation、backward gradient decay、block redundancy 三个症状在 DAR 下有所缓解，说明改进不是单纯来自参数量或训练噪声，而是与跨层路由机制相关。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 30–45 分钟。先看诊断图，尤其是 Fig. 2 及对应章节，确认三类 residual 症状如何随 depth 和 timestep 变化。再看 DAR 公式，重点理解它如何用 adaLN-conditioned hidden state 产生 query，以及为什么 softmax over previous layer outputs 比 running residual 更适合 DiT。实验部分重点看 ImageNet 256×256 的 FID / iteration trade-off、DAR 与 REPA 的组合实验，以及诊断指标和生成质量之间的对应关系。值得深挖的问题是：DAR 的深度 attention 是否会引入明显显存开销，以及同类思想能否迁移到 diffusion LM 或 masked LM。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies cross-layer information flow in Diffusion Transformers. The target is not the attention module, tokenization, or diffusion objective, but the inherited PreNorm residual stream. Standard residual addition creates three coupled issues in DiTs: monotonic hidden-state magnitude growth, sharp backward gradient decay, and increasing block-level redundancy.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture and training-dynamics paper with useful signals for foundation-model research. It revisits a residual-stream issue known from LLMs, but in DiTs the denoising timestep adds an extra axis: high-noise steps emphasize coarse structure, while low-noise steps require fine detail. A fixed, timestep-agnostic residual accumulation rule is therefore a questionable default. The lesson also matters for unified multimodal pretraining, where design choices inherited from autoregressive Transformers may not transfer cleanly to diffusion, flow, or masked generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first diagnoses DiTs along both depth and denoising timestep, measuring hidden-state magnitude, gradient flow, and block-wise redundancy. It then proposes Diffusion-Adaptive Routing, or DAR, as a drop-in replacement for ordinary residual accumulation. Instead of passing a running residual through the stack, each sublayer aggregates previous sublayer outputs through a softmax attention over depth. The query is computed from the current adaLN-modulated hidden state, which gives the routing both content dependence and timestep dependence. This differs from U-Net-style long skip connections: it does not manually pair shallow and deep layers, and it does not impose a fixed hierarchy. It keeps the Transformer stack homogeneous while making cross-layer aggregation learnable, non-incremental, and timestep-adaptive. The method is also compatible with representation-alignment objectives such as REPA.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are on ImageNet 256×256. With SiT-XL/2, DAR reaches 7.56 FID, improving the matched-compute vanilla SiT baseline by 2.11 FID. It also reaches the baseline’s converged quality with roughly 8.75× fewer training iterations. When combined with REPA, DAR gives about a 2× early-stage training acceleration over REPA alone. The paper further links the quality gains to the diagnostic measurements: DAR reduces the magnitude inflation, gradient decay, and block redundancy observed under the standard residual stream.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim to semi-deep read in about 30–45 minutes. Start with the diagnostic figures, especially Fig. 2 and the related analysis of depth-by-timestep behavior. Then read the DAR formulation carefully: the key is how the adaLN-conditioned hidden state produces the depth-routing query, and why attention over previous sublayer outputs differs from ordinary residual accumulation. In the experiments, focus on the FID-versus-iteration trade-off, the combination with REPA, and the connection between diagnostic metrics and generation quality. A useful follow-up question is whether similar routing can help diffusion LMs or masked language models, and what memory overhead the depth attention introduces.

recommendation.zh: DiT残差信息流的分析对理解扩散模型训练动态有启发，DAR即插即用的设计值得在LLM扩散建模范式中尝试复现。只看§3诊断分析和§4 DAR设计即可。
recommendation.en: The analysis of residual information flow in DiTs sheds light on diffusion model training dynamics; DAR's drop-in design warrants reproduction attempts in diffusion LLM paradigms. Read §3 diagnosis and §4 DAR design only.

paper.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing in Visual Diffusion Transformers:Diagnosis, Boundary Calibration and Evolutionary Roadmap from Routing Collapse to Selective Deadlock
paper.abstract: This paper systematically diagnoses the training failure modes of Token-Choice sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) on video Diffusion Transformers. Starting from a pretrained dense model of about 5 billion parameters, we convert it into an MoE architecture following three laws: routed experts exactly clone the original FFN weights, shared experts are initialized to zero for verification and then to extremely small non-zero noise for actual training, while only the gating networks start from random i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 Token-Choice 稀疏 MoE 放到视频 Diffusion Transformer 后为什么容易失效。核心问题是路由器在视觉扩散模型里并不会自然形成类似语言 MoE 的专家分工，而是会出现 routing collapse、global deadlock 和 selective deadlock 等训练动态问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 训练稳定性和跨模态扩展。语言模型里的 MoE 假设，依赖离散且语义密度较高的 token；视频 DiT 的视觉 patch token 冗余更强，还受扩散 timestep、空间结构和多任务条件影响。论文的价值在于把“MoE 在视觉生成里收益有限”拆成可观测的路由动态问题，而不是只报告最终生成质量。它对多模态基座、视频生成基座和 MoE 架构迁移有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从一个预训练 dense 视频生成模型出发，将 FFN 转成 MoE。实验设置包括：routed experts 直接从原 dense FFN 进行 1:1 权重克隆；shared experts 在验证阶段可置零以保证输出等价，训练阶段用极小非零噪声初始化，例如 1e-4；router 从随机初始化开始学习。这个设置的目的，是尽量排除专家初始能力差异，让失效主要暴露在路由学习本身。论文比较了从 linear router 到 cross-attention router 的结构演进，并提出若干诊断概念：global deadlock 指路由整体塌到少数专家；selective deadlock 指全局塌缩缓解后，仍有部分层长期退化为单专家使用；U-shaped deadlock distribution 指死锁层集中在浅层视觉处理层和深层语义整合层，中间层更平衡。作者还提出 functional redundancy hypothesis，把部分死锁解释为视觉 token 冗余和层功能分工下的一种阶段性资源分配，而不完全是优化失败。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Kiwi-Edit 设置，包含 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 视频扩散 backbone 和 Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct 多模态 encoder，总规模约 8B；dense 视频生成 backbone 约 5B。作者在 9-in-1 多任务视频生成场景中进行诊断。论文提到对 30 层网络、超过 6500 万 token 的时序数据进行层级分析，并在 5000 step、超过 34 亿 token 的路由决策轨迹上观察训练动态。关键现象包括：即使提高 auxiliary loss，也仍有约三分之一层退化为单专家使用；死锁并非均匀分布，而是呈浅层和深层更严重的 U 形分布；更强的 router 设计可以缓解全局死锁，但会暴露 selective deadlock 这类更局部、更稳定的退化模式。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 40 分钟。优先看实验设置，确认 dense-to-MoE 转换、专家克隆、shared expert 初始化和 router 初始化是否足够控制变量。然后看 failure mode 的定义和对应曲线，尤其是 global deadlock、selective deadlock、U-shaped layer distribution。若时间有限，跳过生成样例，重点读路由负载、层级分布、auxiliary loss 消融和 router 结构对比。值得深挖的是：selective deadlock 到底是视觉 token 冗余导致的合理稀疏化，还是 auxiliary objective 与 diffusion loss 不匹配造成的优化偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why Token-Choice sparse MoE often fails when inserted into video Diffusion Transformers. The central issue is that visual diffusion models do not automatically develop the kind of expert specialization observed in language MoEs; instead, their routers can enter routing collapse, global deadlock, or selective deadlock.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to pretraining through MoE stability and cross-modal scaling. Language MoE success relies on discrete, semantically dense tokens, while video DiT tokens are spatially redundant and are affected by diffusion timesteps, spatial structure, and multi-task conditioning. The useful part is the diagnostic framing: limited gains from visual MoE are traced to measurable routing dynamics rather than treated as a vague architecture failure. This matters for multimodal foundation models, video generation backbones, and attempts to transfer LLM MoE recipes to visual generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors start from a pretrained dense video generation model and convert its FFN blocks into MoE modules. Routed experts are cloned one-to-one from the original dense FFN weights. Shared experts are zero-initialized for verification, to preserve output equivalence, and initialized with tiny non-zero noise such as 1e-4 for training. Routers are randomly initialized and trained from scratch. This controlled setup is designed to expose routing failures rather than expert-capacity differences. The paper compares an architectural progression from linear routers to cross-attention routers and defines several failure modes. Global deadlock refers to broad collapse into a small number of experts. Selective deadlock appears after global collapse is reduced, where a subset of layers still degenerates into near single-expert usage. The reported U-shaped deadlock distribution means deadlocked layers concentrate in shallow visual-processing layers and deep semantic-integration layers, while middle layers remain more balanced. The functional redundancy hypothesis interprets some deadlock as phased resource allocation under visual-token redundancy, rather than pure optimizer failure.
summary_en.experiments: The diagnostic setup is based on Kiwi-Edit, using a Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video diffusion backbone and a Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct multimodal encoder, for roughly 8B total parameters; the dense video backbone is about 5B. Experiments are conducted in a 9-in-1 multi-task video generation setting. The paper reports layerwise temporal analysis on a 30-layer network with more than 65 million tokens, and routing-decision traces over 5,000 steps and more than 3.4 billion tokens. Key observations include: roughly one third of layers can collapse into single-expert usage even when the auxiliary loss is increased; deadlock is not uniformly distributed but follows a shallow-and-deep U-shaped pattern; stronger router designs reduce global deadlock but reveal more local and persistent selective deadlock.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 40 minutes. Start with the dense-to-MoE conversion details, especially expert cloning, shared-expert initialization, and router initialization, because these choices determine whether the diagnosis is well controlled. Then read the definitions and plots for global deadlock, selective deadlock, and the U-shaped layer distribution. If time is limited, skip qualitative generation examples and focus on routing load, layerwise distribution, auxiliary-loss ablations, and router-architecture comparisons. The main question worth probing is whether selective deadlock reflects a reasonable sparsification caused by visual-token redundancy, or an optimization artifact caused by mismatch between the auxiliary routing objective and the diffusion training loss.

recommendation.zh: 视频扩散Transformer中MoE路由失效的系统诊断，5层失效模式对LLM MoE也有类比参考价值，尤其MLP路由器选择性死lock现象值得注意。只看§3-4诊断部分即可。
recommendation.en: Systematic diagnosis of MoE routing failures in video diffusion Transformers. The 5 failure modes (especially MLP router selective deadlock) have analogical value for LLM MoE. Read only §3-4 diagnosis.

summary.core_problem: 像素空间扩散Transformer（DiT）是否需要引入ViT中常用的register token，以及其作用机制尚不明确
summary.importance: 首次系统分析register token在像素空间DiT中的作用，修正了register仅用于解决token离群值的固有认知，属于架构机制分析类贡献
summary.technical_approach: 在多种像素空间DiT架构上做对照消融，分析中间层特征分布、收敛速度与生成质量的差异

summary_en.importance: First systematic analysis of register tokens in pixel-space DiTs, correcting the prior belief that registers only work by eliminating token outliers; a contribution to architecture mechanism analysis
summary_en.technical_approach: Controlled ablation studies on multiple pixel-space DiT architectures, analyzing differences in intermediate feature distributions, convergence speed, and generation quality
summary_en.experiments: Tested on multiple image generation benchmarks; register tokens improve FID and convergence speed. Verifies DiTs have no patch-token outliers; registers work by improving feature quality at high noise levels
summary_en.authors_note: Yandex Research team, with Artem Babenko as a senior deep learning researcher at the institution

recommendation.en: Only weak reference for researchers working on Diffusion LM or unified Transformer architecture; read Section 3 feature analysis only, rest is CV-specific

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion material transfer 对文本提示、参考网络和复杂辅助结构依赖较强，导致条件不稳、特征错位和推理开销偏高的问题。

summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tsinghua University、Pengcheng Laboratory、National Cheng-Kung University、Great Bay University 等；这是图形与视觉生成方向工作，不是通用多模态基座预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses diffusion-based material transfer methods that depend on text prompts, reference networks, or complex auxiliary modules, causing unstable control, feature misalignment, and higher inference cost.
summary_en.importance: It is an image/material-generation method contribution: geometry and lighting conditions replace text guidance, while lightweight LoRA and attention modifications reduce the cost of multi-condition control.
summary_en.technical_approach: DealMaTe conditions on depth, normal, and lighting images. Multi-Dim 3D Shader LoRA injects compatible 3D control signals without modifying the base model weights, while Shader Causal Mutual Attention and KV caching reduce latency under multiple conditions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide training scale, backbone details, baselines, or numerical metrics. It claims more harmonious and stable material transfer than methods relying on image fine-tuning, text guidance, or reference networks, with improved inference efficiency.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua University, Pengcheng Laboratory, National Cheng-Kung University, Great Bay University, and related labs. The work sits in graphics and visual generation rather than foundation-model pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 只看条件注入和注意力缓存设计即可；它是图像生成工程改进，不会改变语言建模判断。
